name: t4_lean
idea: the upper body leans toward the staff (pit of the neck and head 3 px toward it) so the near shoulder comes to the grip and the elbow can bend; the weight heel moves under the new plumb line
failed: FG-P10: weight leg 6.0 deg; free knee bend 21 deg; free knee +1.8 px lower
verdict: dropped (#6, 10/11): the full 3 px lean moved the weight heel and tipped the weight leg to 6 deg (FG-P10); t7 is the same idea at two-thirds strength
